name: AppSignal
author: Memo Uranga
description: AppSignal at a glance: open anomaly alerts, error and performance incidents, server (CPU/memory/disk/load) health, uptime monitors, background job queues, check-ins and last deploy for every app you can see, in a native Omarchy bar panel.

barWidget.description: One bar icon with an alert dot, one panel: per-app open anomaly alerts, errors, slow actions, server health, uptime monitors, job queues and failing check-ins, with click-to-open incident rows.

schema.label: Enter / left click on an incident
schema.description: "agent" runs `omarchy agent prompt` to investigate the incident; "browser" opens it on appsignal.com instead. Right-click or `o` always opens the browser.

schema.label: Show only apps pinned in AppSignal
schema.description: "pinned" shows only the apps you pinned in AppSignal, as long as you've pinned at least one; "all" always shows every app. No boolean setting type exists in this Omarchy's schema, hence the enum.

schema.label: Job queue wait time warn threshold (ms)
Job queues to ignore
schema.description: Comma-separated queue names the JOBS section leaves out entirely, e.g. "mailers, low_priority". Empty shows every queue.

schema.label: Visible sections, in order
schema.description: Comma-separated section keys, in the order you want them on screen: alerts, errors, performance, servers, uptime, jobs, checkins, deploy. Leaving one out hides it; for performance, servers and jobs that also skips their request to the AppSignal metrics API. Unknown keys are ignored.

schema.label: App tab order
schema.description: "attention" (default) puts apps with something wrong first; "name" is alphabetical; "pinned" keeps the order AppSignal itself returns, unsorted.
